description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jalon Daniels could start for the Bucs on Sunday against the Lions.
items.impact: The status of Baker Mayfield is unclear as he deals with a foot strain. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Jalon Daniels could start in Week 11 for Buccaneers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Baker Mayfield is uncertain for Week 11 as he deals with a foot strain.
items.impact: Mayfield will need to be monitored in practice this week. If he sits, Jalon Daniels would start on Sunday against the Lions.
items.title: Baker Mayfield (foot) uncertain for Week 11

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ian Rapoport said he "wouldn't be surprised" if Kenneth Walker sat in Week 11 to make sure that his groin is fully healed.
items.impact: The Chiefs enter this week as huge favorites against the Cardinals. Emmett Johnson could get another week to be in the workhorse role in the Chiefs backfield.
items.title: Kenneth Walker III (groin) could sit Week 11

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals signed WR Ronnie Bell to their practice squad.
items.impact: Bell will add depth in the wide receiver room for Arizona. He will remain off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Ronnie Bell signs with Cardinals practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins signed K Daniel Carlson to their practice squad.
items.impact: Carlson will likely get a chance to start this week with Zane Gonzalez released.
items.title: Daniel Carlson signs with Dolphins practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns claimed EDGE Jamree Kromah off waivers from the Dolphins.
items.impact: Kromah was waived by the Dolphins. He will add depth on the defensive line for Cleveland.
items.title: Jamree Kromah claimed off waivers by Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens released K Harrison Mevis from the practice squad.
items.impact: Mevis will seek another opportunity.
items.title: Harrison Mevis released by Ravens

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Chiefs worked out veteran K Matt Prater.
items.impact: Kansas City continues to address the kicker position given the struggles of Harrison Butker.
items.title: Matt Prater works out for Chiefs

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Charvarius Ward Sr. did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Ward remains uncertain on a short week for Thursday's game against the Texans.
items.title: Charvarius Ward Sr. (knee) misses practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bernhard Raimann did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Raimann will likely be ruled out on a short week.
items.title: Bernhard Raimann (concussion) misses practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Will Mallory did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Mallory's status is uncertain on a short week due to a hamstring injury.
items.title: Will Mallory (hamstring) misses practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Anthony Gould was limited in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Gould will need to be monitored in practice on Wednesday on a short week.
items.title: Anthony Gould (toe) limited in practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Sauce Gardner did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Gardner came out of Sunday's game with a calf injury. His status is uncertain for Thursday's game against the Texans.
items.title: Sauce Gardner (calf) misses practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles signed DT Leki Fotu to their practice squad.
items.impact: Fotu will add depth on the defensive line for Philadelphia.
items.title: Leki Fotu signs with Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles signed RB Jaydon Blue to their active roster.
items.impact: Blue was released by the Eagles last week. He'll remain off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Jaydon Blue signs with Eagles' active roster

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Xavier Restrepo has been promoted to the Titans active roster following the team placing Wan'Dale Robinson on IR with an ankle injury.
items.impact: Restrepo could have some sneaky PPR usage as the Titans primary slot receiver for the next few weeks. His floor and ceiling will likely be on the low end, but the usability could still be there for those in a pinch.
items.title: Xavier Restrepo promoted to active roster

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) has been placed on Injured Reserve with an ankle injury.
items.impact: With Robinson out, the Titans promoted Xavier Restrepo to the active roster. Robinson will miss a minimum of four games. Restrepo on the other hand, could see some PPR viability as a primary slot receiver.
items.title: Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) placed on Injured Reserve

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dolphins DT Jordan Phillips will miss the remainder of the season with torn biceps he suffered in the team's loss to the Colts in Week 10.
items.impact: It is a brutal blow for the Dolphins defense as Phillips was slated to play more following the injury to Zach Sieler.
items.title: Jordan Phillips (torn biceps) out for season

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cowboys waived OL Ajani Cornelius.
items.impact: Cornelius will seek another opportunity.
items.title: Ajani Cornelius waived by Cowboys

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cowboys signed OL Nick Leverett to their active roster.
items.impact: Leverett spent time on the active roster earlier this season and appeared in five games.
items.title: Nick Leverett signs with Cowboys active roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kyle Monangai practiced again on Tuesday.
items.impact: Monangai continues to trend towards returning on Sunday against the Bucs.
items.title: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) practices Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Vega Ioane is dealing with a shoulder injury.
items.impact: Ioane will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.
items.title: Vega Ioane dealing with shoulder injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Nnamdi Madubuike is dealing with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Madubuike will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.
items.title: Nnamdi Madubuike suffers hamstring injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said the team expects TJ Hockenson "to progress" ahead of Minnesota's Week 11 game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Hockenson missed practice all of last week. He'll need to be monitored in practice this week.
items.title: T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest) to progress ahead of Week 11

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders opened the practice window for Jacory Croskey-Merritt.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt has been on injured reserve with a groin injury. He'll have 21 days to be activated.
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) has practice window opened
